visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor room, possibly a Mahjong club. Four young men are seated around an automatic Mahjong table. The main character, wearing white-framed glasses and a white graphic T-shirt, gestures towards the camera while holding a tile. (2) The camera focuses on the table surface as green and white Mahjong tiles are shuffled and discarded. A man in a black T-shirt across the table looks down thoughtfully. Yellow and white captions appear at the bottom of the frame. (3) The man in white glasses smiles and points at his hand of tiles. The background shows wooden wall panels and a black ergonomic chair. (4) A sequence of fast cuts shows different hands being played. Hands reach in to draw or discard tiles with quick, precise movements. (5) One player reveals a winning hand, a 'Five Hidden Triplets' (Wu An Ke). The camera zooms in on the specific tiles. The other players lean in to look, their faces showing expressions of shock and amusement. (6) The setting shifts slightly to a carpeted area where a man in a white shirt is performing push-ups as a penalty. Other people stand around him, holding smartphones to record the scene. (7) A woman in a blue top holds a smartphone showing a video call of another man's face. The main character in white glasses appears again, smiling and making a 'V' sign next to the phone screen.
